name: settings-toggle-flow
title: Settings Toggle Flow
description: A two-column settings card: it blurs in, then a cursor flips the notifications switch, opens the theme select and picks an option, drags the volume slider, and clicks Save, ending on a confirmation toast.
useWhen: Showing a complete settings interaction walkthrough for a product demo with zero assembly.
Demonstrating several UI primitives orchestrated in sequence: switch, select, slider, then toast.
You need a ready settings scene and the default layout matches your content.
avoidWhen: You only need one control type: use switch, select or slider individually.
Your settings layout differs from the two-column card: compose the primitives manually.
You need custom cursor timing or interaction order: wire cursor with the individual primitives.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Heading on the left of the card.

variables.label: Description
variables.default: Manage how you receive alerts, set your theme, and tune the volume.

variables.label: Row labels
variables.description: JSON array of three labels: switch, select, slider.

variables.label: Select items
variables.description: JSON array of select options; the first is the trigger label, the cursor picks the last.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
